author: Ryan Clark
title: New AEW Trios Champion Crowned + Lots More - NewsBreak
text:
By Ryan Clark ,
35 minutes ago
AEW has crowned new Trios Champions.
The AEW Trios Championships changed hands on this week’s episode of Dynamite, as The Conglomeration (Kyle O’Reilly, Orange Cassidy, and Roderick Strong) defended the titles against The Demand, represented by Ricochet and GOA.
The challengers pulled off a major upset to capture the championships after outside interference proved to be the difference. During the closing moments, Blake Christian hit Orange Cassidy with the championship belt following a springboard attack. The opening allowed Ricochet to connect with his Spirit Gun finisher on Cassidy to secure the three-count and win the titles for The Demand.
The defeat brings The Conglomeration’s Trios Championship reign to an end after 108 days. The group originally captured the titles from The Dogs at AEW Dynasty and successfully retained them against teams including the Don Callis Family and The Opps before ultimately losing the belts on Wednesday night.
AEW has announced several new matches for the upcoming Grand Slam: Mexico event.
READ MORE: What Happened Before AEW Dynamite Went On The Air? (7/29/26)
READ MORE: Tony Khan – ‘My Father Originally Didn’t Believe In The Idea Of AEW’
Just weeks before challenging for the AEW World Championship at All In, Will Ospreay will go one-on-one with Mark Davis in a high-profile singles match. To ensure a decisive outcome, AEW has confirmed that no outside interference will be permitted.
Another new bout will see Mercedes Mone team with Divine Dominion’s Megan Bayne and Lena Kross to face Willow Nightingale and The Brawling Birds, consisting of Jamie Hayter and Alex Windsor, in six-woman tag team action.
You can check out the updated lineup for AEW: Grand Slam Mexico below:
* No Outside Interference: Will Ospreay vs. Mark Davis
* AEW International Championship: Kyle Fletcher (c) vs. Mike Bailey
* Mercedes Mone & Divine Dominion (Megan Bayne & Lena Kross) vs. Willow Nightingale & Brawling Birds (Jamie Hayter & Alex Windsor)
You can check out the updated lineup for Thursday night’s episode of AEW Collision below:
* Bang Bang Gang vs. The Dogs/Death Riders
* Athena, Billie Starkz, & Diamante vs. The Brawling Birds (Jamie Hayter & Alex Windsor) & Hazuki
* Will Ospreay vs. Daniel Garcia
And finally, you can check out the updated lineup for the AEW vs. CMLL event (8/4/26) below:
* Max Star vs. Leon Cage
* Kira & Candela vs. Maya World & Hyan
* Calaveras Jr & Calvera Jr II vs. the Swirl (Blake Christian & Lee Johnson)
* NJPW Strong Openweight Tag Team Championships: Los Hermanos Chávez (Ángel de Oro and Niebla Roja) (c) vs. Youjiro Takahasi & Douki
* Ultimo Guerrero, Neon, Xelhua, Zandokan vs. Volador Jr, El Clon, Hechicero, Brian Cage
* Soberao Jr vs. Komander
* ROH Championship: Bandido (c) vs. Barbaro Cavernario
* AEW TNT Championship: Kevin Knight (c) vs. Titn
* Kyle Fletcher vs. Mascara Dorada
The event will air on MyAEW.
